description: This Java class 'Hooks' provides Cucumber lifecycle hooks (@Before and @After) to manage WebDriver setup, teardown, and screenshot capture on test failure within Cucumber test scenarios.

classes.name: Hooks
classes.description: Provides Cucumber hooks to initialize and cleanup WebDriver instances around test scenarios, with screenshot capturing on failures.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes WebDriver before each Cucumber scenario, ensuring test isolation.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Cleans up WebDriver after each Cucumber scenario, capturing screenshot on failure for debugging.
